id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Multidrop dual-channel automotive bus. Per channel: passive bus (linear multidrop), passive star, or active star (active couplers regenerate the signal; cascaded within timing limits). The schedule and time base are distributed across all nodes; there is no central master.

supported_topologies.name: Passive bus
supported_topologies.description: Linear multidrop passive bus per channel.

supported_topologies.name: Active star
supported_topologies.description: One or more active star couplers regenerate the signal and isolate branches; cascaded active stars allowed within timing limits.

supported_topologies.name: Dual-channel redundant
supported_topologies.description: Both channels carry the same data for fault tolerance.

supported_topologies.name: Dual-channel bandwidth
supported_topologies.description: Channels carry different data for doubled bandwidth.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Implements the FlexRay protocol; follows the distributed TDMA schedule; no single CC is a master.
Sends sync frames that provide clock-synchronization timing references.
Sends startup frames (and CAS for the leader) to start the cluster; >=2 required.

fields.interconnect_role: FlexRay is a deterministic dual-channel automotive backbone. The TDMA schedule guarantees collision-free, bounded-latency delivery in the static segment; the FTDMA dynamic segment grants prioritized on-demand bandwidth. Clock synchronization keeps every node on a common {cycle, macrotick} time base.

ordering_guarantees.static_segment: Strict TDMA order by slot number; bounded latency and jitter.
ordering_guarantees.dynamic_segment: Priority order by Frame ID (lower = higher priority); a low-priority frame may be deferred in a busy cycle.
ordering_guarantees.channel: Channels A and B are independent; redundant frames are compared at the receiver.
ordering_guarantees.cycle: Cycles ordered by the 6-bit cycle counter; cycle-multiplexed scheduling supported.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: FlexRay is not memory-mapped; frames are addressed by Frame ID and slot/cycle, not by a memory or peripheral address. The host exchanges frame buffers with the CC over the Controller Host Interface (CHI).

device_classification.communication_controller: Protocol engine node attached to one or both channels.
device_classification.bus_driver: Per-channel transceiver between CC and BP/BM.
device_classification.active_star_coupler: Regenerates and isolates branch signals on a channel.
